\[
\hat{x} = y - f_\theta(y)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The noisy image
- \(f_\theta\): The network with its trained weights
- \(\hat{x}\): The restored image

y is the noisy image and f is the network. Instead of the clean image, DnCNN learns the noise, the residual, and subtracts it. Batch normalization made training stable, and in the released weights it is merged into the convolutions.
